metrics.name: Completeness
metrics.evidence: Capability inventory; core workflows, bindings and operations exist
metrics.deficiency: Lifecycle/composition support is uneven; some public research and receipt workflows are partial

metrics.name: Correctness
metrics.evidence: D03–D10; independent-oracle and boundary tests
metrics.deficiency: Multiple reproducible or source-traced identity, ordering and concurrency failures

metrics.name: Depth
metrics.evidence: BM25/WAND, dense exact/ANN, updates, temporal memory, provenance
metrics.deficiency: Sophistication is established; common workflow composition needs improvement

metrics.name: Workflow coverage
metrics.evidence: Remember/recall/forget, migration, recovery and service flows
metrics.deficiency: Native held-out QA U; restore, resumable migration and multi-wrapper semantics incomplete

metrics.name: Consistency
metrics.evidence: D06–D08; distinct MCP, core and binding contracts
metrics.deficiency: Similarity meaning, model identity and capability defaults vary by path

metrics.name: Interoperability
metrics.evidence: Broad SDKs, official MCP SDK, independent W3C artifacts
metrics.deficiency: Uneven APIs/releases, framework filtering and OAuth flow gaps

metrics.name: Architecture
metrics.evidence: Explicit writer/read publication separation and shared owners
metrics.deficiency: Large HmsCore coupling; multiple model, memory and index lifecycle implementations

metrics.name: Code quality
metrics.evidence: Idiomatic modules, checked ingest boundaries, property tests
metrics.deficiency: Local unchecked native/numeric boundaries, panics and duplicated contracts

metrics.name: Extensibility
metrics.evidence: Traits, feature flags and backend boundaries
metrics.deficiency: Extension hooks can bypass semantic atomicity; several public research APIs lack isolation

metrics.name: Dependencies
metrics.evidence: Cargo.lock, cargo-deny, pinned release actions and model packs
metrics.deficiency: Unmaintained serialization dependency; advisory exceptions need ongoing review; D16

metrics.name: State/data integrity
metrics.evidence: Journal/checkpoint guarantees contrasted with D02–D06/D11
metrics.deficiency: High-level policy, issuance and optional-state transitions escape the durable invariant

metrics.name: Maintainability
metrics.evidence: Extensive module/test/docs organization
metrics.deficiency: Surface breadth and duplicated identities/lifecycles raise change and diagnosis cost

metrics.name: Standards conformance
metrics.evidence: Section V; independent VC subset checks
metrics.deficiency: COSE required header handling fails; complete conformance/crypto lifecycle U

metrics.name: Interface/API design
metrics.evidence: Typed Rust/TS/serde APIs, central route/scope table, problem details
metrics.deficiency: Generic memory OpenAPI objects, boundary panics and ambiguous commit/error outcomes

metrics.name: Protocol interoperability
metrics.evidence: MCP SDK and W3C independent verification
metrics.deficiency: Full MCP transport suite U; static bearer discovery and SCITT receipts partial

metrics.name: Discoverability
metrics.evidence: Guides, generated declarations/schemas, index/security status, explain
metrics.deficiency: Capability availability and source-versus-release support scattered

metrics.name: Compatibility
metrics.evidence: Versioned formats/schema, feature/MSRV/platform CI configuration
metrics.deficiency: Incomplete effective embedding identity; exact released artifact/runtime parity U

metrics.name: Integration fidelity
metrics.evidence: Source offsets/provenance and importer mapping inspection
metrics.deficiency: D03 collisions, model changes, truncation and capped residual filters alter semantics

metrics.name: Reliability
metrics.evidence: Recovery/property tests and bounded core/server design
metrics.deficiency: Optional downloads, WASM close and some publication failures remain fragile

metrics.name: Recovery
metrics.evidence: Generation publication, cache discard, interruption tests
metrics.deficiency: Restore crash window, post-commit effects and optional governance recovery gaps

metrics.name: Security
metrics.evidence: Strong scoped HTTP auth, AEAD, strict signature checks
metrics.deficiency: .NET unsafe allocation and COSE semantic boundary defects; resource caps incomplete

metrics.name: Data safety
metrics.evidence: Atomic core batches, ownership, encryption and source schema
metrics.deficiency: Import identity loss, cross-wrapper overwrite, status-slot reuse and restore risks

metrics.name: Performance
metrics.evidence: Specific matched-recall ANN/text results, honest losses
metrics.deficiency: Build/RSS/cold-start losses, filtered scan paths; invalid historical measurements excluded from advantage claims

metrics.name: Scalability
metrics.evidence: Parallel core, admission limits, mmap/delta/checkpoint mechanisms
metrics.deficiency: Filtered scans, unbounded analytic frontiers and MCP pending work; operating ceiling U

metrics.name: Developer experience
metrics.evidence: Examples, CLI tools, multi-runtime packages, diagnostics
metrics.deficiency: Broad setup matrix; source/release mismatch and narrower Python-native API require care

metrics.name: Documentation
metrics.evidence: Extensive candid docs, format and threat-model specifications
metrics.deficiency: Stale plaintext-cache warning and invalid benchmark rows still published

metrics.name: Validation
metrics.evidence: CI/fuzz/golden/property/oracle/interop infrastructure; Section VIII
metrics.deficiency: Risk-boundary tests miss observed defects; native held-out QA and several runtime paths U

metrics.name: Observability
metrics.evidence: HTTP health/metrics/logs, storage/index diagnostics, recall explanations
metrics.deficiency: No common cross-surface trace of policy→retrieval→generation/sidecar outcomes or resource budgets

metrics.name: Differentiation
metrics.evidence: Local hybrid/VSA/provenance combination and scoped measured wins
metrics.deficiency: No broad frontier superiority; native end-to-end memory advantage unproven

metrics.name: Innovation potential

metrics.deficiency: Utility and safety of new combinations require falsifiable task experiments
